dcsync-4662-properties.xml.note: The exact shape a real 4662 has: the replication GUID lives in Properties and ObjectType holds the domain class GUID. The pre-fix rule matched ObjectType and could never fire.

dcsync-4662-dc-machine-account.xml.note: A DC replicating as its machine account is normal AD behaviour - must not alert, and must not be counted as enumeration either.

ntlm-4776-successful-validations.xml.note: 8x 4776 with Status 0x0 (credentials VALIDATED). The pre-fix rule never read Status, so healthy NTLM traffic raised a High alert.

ntlm-4776-failed-validations.xml.note: Genuine failure burst - must still fire.

uac-4738-no-net-change.xml.note: The account already had DONT_REQ_PREAUTH before this edit. The pre-fix rule tested the NEW flags only, so any edit re-alerted at Critical.

uac-4738-already-disabled.xml.note: Edit on an account that is already disabled - no flag moved.

kerberoasting-4769-mixed.xml.note: krbtgt and the machine SPN HOST/PC01 are excluded; the single user SPN MSSQLSvc/sql01 with RC4 is the roast, reported at Medium because one RC4 ticket on its own is not proof of a sweep.

kerberoasting-4769-failure.xml.note: Failed ticket request (Status 0x6) - nothing was issued, nothing to crack.

asrep-4768-single-request.xml.note: ONE no-preauth TGT request (PreAuthType 0). The pre-fix rule waited for 3 hits on the same account, so a normal one-shot roast was missed.

eventlog-1100-service-stopped.xml.note: Microsoft's reference XML for 1100 has <Channel>Security</Channel>. Polling the System log for it (pre-fix) meant this rule could never fire.

account-created-4720-computer.xml.note: Machine account created by a domain join - routine.

account-created-4720-user.xml.note: A user account created by an administrator.

privesc-4728-two-accounts.xml.note: Two DIFFERENT accounts added to Domain Admins. The pre-fix dedupe key was the rule key alone, so the second add inside 15 minutes was swallowed.

logon-4624-service-account-type3.xml.note: Routine type-3 network logon by a service account - this is the noise the pre-fix rule produced.

uac-4738-delegation-granted.xml.note: DONT_REQ_PREAUTH was already absent; what changed is TRUSTED_FOR_DELEGATION (0x80000) being newly set. Unconstrained delegation lets an attacker who owns the account impersonate any user to any service, so it is reported at High - and ONLY when the bit actually moved.

uac-4738-delegation-unchanged.xml.note: The account already had unconstrained delegation before this edit. The rule compares new AND NOT old, so re-saving the account is silent.

kerberoasting-4769-sweep.xml.note: Three distinct user-owned RC4 service principals requested by one account inside the window: a kerberoasting sweep. One alert, escalated in place to High (a single SPN is only Medium).

firewall-4950-profile-disabled.xml.note: The real 4950 shape (Microsoft Learn event XML): ProfileChanged + SettingType + SettingValue. SettingType 'EnableFirewall' with value 'No' is the whole-profile OFF switch - Critical, T1562.004. Shares the MPSSVC Rule-Level Policy Change subcategory with 4946-4949, so no new auditpol entry is needed.

firewall-4950-benign-settings.xml.note: A 4950 for a non-EnableFirewall setting (Default Outbound Action -> Block) and an EnableFirewall=Yes (turning it ON) - neither is a disable, neither may alert.

logon-4624-anonymous-smb.xml.note: Type-3 logon with TargetUserSid S-1-5-7 / ANONYMOUS LOGON - the null-session shape RID-cycling tooling produces. Deduped per source IP per hour.

logon-4624-named-network-logon.xml.note: A type-3 logon with a REAL account - ordinary network traffic, must not be treated as a null session.

gpo-5136-group-policy-modified.xml.note: A GPO (groupPolicyContainer) was modified by an administrator - displayName attribute changed.

gpo-5136-gplink-modified.xml.note: A GPO link (gPLink) on an OU was modified - potential GPO-based persistence.

gpo-5136-adminsdholder-modified.xml.note: AdminSDHolder nTSecurityDescriptor was modified - controls default security for all protected admin groups (SDProp). This is Critical.

gpo-5136-sidhistory-modified.xml.note: sIDHistory was added to a service account - Golden Ticket / SID History injection indicator. This is Critical.

gpo-5136-machine-account-benign.xml.note: A DC machine account (DC01$) modifying a GPO is normal - must not alert.

computer-4741-nonadmin-create.xml.note: A non-admin user (jsmith) created a computer account - unauthorized.

computer-4742-delegation-change.xml.note: An admin modified a computer account's delegation attribute (msDS-AllowedToActOnBehalfOfOtherIdentity) - potential RBCD attack.

computer-4741-admin-create-benign.xml.note: An admin creating a computer account is normal domain join activity.
